message: Hi John, have you heard anything about Mr. Thompson? He hasn't been around lately, and I'm getting worried. I remember that he is your former boss and you are working in the community heath center as a nurse, so I guess you know something.
Morning John! Don't forget the community meeting next Thursday.
John, can you send me the details of the wellness initiative again? Thanks!
John, I baked some cookies for you. Stop by when you have time!
Hey, my pipes are acting up again. Could you recommend a good time for a house call?
John, the flower arrangement for the wellness center is ready for pickup.
Did you see the news about the flu going around? Hope our seniors are okay.
John, your car is fixed. You can pick it up anytime.
I'm organizing a book club meeting next week. Would love for you to join!
Hey John, any tips for dealing with kids' colds this season?
